discovery.summary: Checked primary pages since the 2026-11-09 run. One significant new instrument: the Paris Declaration on AI Safety and Security (9 Nov 2026), signed by governments and frontier developers; drafted as a question (addition, Layer 5 recommended). No other new instruments: AISR publications unchanged (latest Feb 2026 report); NAAIMES latest is the Jul 2026 Seoul meeting; Geneva summit 21-22 Jun 2027 unchanged; CoE treaty table unchanged since P-0161 v2 (EU and Bosnia and Herzegovina ratified, not in force); UN Panel latest output 21 Sep thematic brief; HAIP next submission deadline 15 Jan 2027.
